annotations.title: Filing check: the document against its XBRL

description: Every number in a 10-K or 10-Q read twice: as a person reads the document and as machines read its inline XBRL. Lists each figure tagged at a scale other than the unit its table or words state, each fact tagged twice with different values, each sum in the filing's own calculation that does not add up, and each fact SEC's company facts hold differently or not at all, with a link to the figure, and counts of what was checked.

accession.description: Check this filing (a 10-K or 10-Q, or an amendment of one), whatever form says.

filings.description: Check the latest this many filings of the form, newest first; default 1.

name: filing_check

outputSchema.description: results has one entry per filing, newest first: filing, checked (what was read and compared, by check), findings (rows in the order of columns: kind, concept, period, unit, dimensions, displayed, value as tagged, compared_with, where, url, reading) and plain_reading; or error, for a filing that could not be read.

title: Filing check: the document against its XBRL
